en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ in Central
en.dek: Free exhibition of 14 prototypes under the theme Better, Not Perfect runs until 29 November from 11am to 8pm.
body: PMQ is hosting deTour 2026, Hong Kong’s annual design festival, from 20 to 29 November at its Central premises on Aberdeen Street. Organised by PMQ and supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency, the event is free to enter.

This year’s theme is Better, Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, with curator-at-large Shin Wong. The festival displays 14 works by local, mainland and international creators across speculative tools, adaptive materials, social design and immersive experiences.

Opening hours are 11am to 8pm from 21 to 29 November, with a shorter session on the opening day. A pop-up shop, workshops, dialogues and guided tours are also part of the programme. Visitors can reach PMQ via Sheung Wan or Central MTR stations.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節於中環PMQ元創方繼續舉行
zh.dek: 以「不完美，更美好」為主題的免費展覽展出14件原型作品，活動至11月29日，每日上午11時至晚上8時開放。
body: PMQ元創方於中環鴨巴甸街舉辦年度設計節deTour 2026，日期為11月20日至29日。活動由元創方主辦，並獲文創產業發展處支持，入場免費。
本屆主題為「BETTER, NOT PERFECT 不完美，更美好：Prototypes for Tomorrow」，總策展人為黃馨。展覽匯聚14件來自本地、內地及海外創作者的作品，涵蓋推想工具、適應物料、社會設計及沉浸體驗。
除開幕日外，每日開放時間為上午11時至晚上8時。現場設有快閃店、工作坊、對話及導賞團。市民可乘港鐵上環或中環站前往。
